title: Apple CEO Tim Cook to visit India next week, likely to inaugurate first retail stores
title_hi: एप्पल के सीईओ टिम कुक अगले हफ्ते भारत आएंगे, संभवतः पहले रिटेल स्टोर का करेंगे उद्घाटन
details: Apple CEO Tim Cook is expected to visit India next week, marking a significant moment for the tech giant's presence in the country. His visit is anticipated to coincide with the launch of Apple's first official retail stores in India, with Mumbai and Delhi being the likely locations. This move signifies Apple's increasing focus on the Indian market and its strategy to connect more directly with consumers.
hook: क्या टिम कुक भारत में खोलेंगे एप्पल के पहले स्टोर? जानें पूरी खबर!
